preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S are either '0' or '1'.
The length of the string S is between 2 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for start in range(len(S)) for end in range(start + 1, len(S) + 1) if S[start:end].count('1') > S[start:end].count('0'))
postconditions.description: The function returns the number of substrings of S that have more '1's than '0's.
